{{Quote|I just&hellip; I just wanted something ''back''. I guess I felt like&hellip; like they ''owed'' me.|Chopper, on the Confederate battle droids|audio=ChopperTheyOwedMe-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
'''Chopper''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An aggressive [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], Chopper was scarred during a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] ambush on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and he came to hold a personal grudge against his [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] adversaries. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was dispatched with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led contingent of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the Confederacy. When the Separatists foiled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] attempt to ambush them, Chopper and his [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] were forced to retreat with the rest of the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] back to their [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]]. While there, Chopper secretly made war trophies out of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fingers pilfered from the battlefield, an exploit he was later forced to disclose when his superiors, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], interrogated his unit to root out a potential Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Although Slick framed Chopper to be the enemy agent, the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] himself was revealed to be the turncoat and was apprehended after [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaging]] the Republic's military supplies.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This isn't good, Chopper. Lying about where you were? Taking forbidden items from a ''battlefield?''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''I know.''"<br />"''I put up with the attitude because you have ''skill''. But if you could break these rules, your whole character's in question here.''"<br />"''Wait, no. Hang on. I'm no spy!|Slick and Chopper|audio=ChopperImNoSpy-TheHiddenEnemy.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
[[File:Choppercrutch.png|thumb|left|300px|Chopper insults a crippled Christophsian refugee.]]
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] nicknamed Chopper<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="DB clone troopers" /> During the course of his service in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he sustained heavy scarring from a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] ambush on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was also [[Color/Legends|discolored]]<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy|d=y}}</ref> from a head injury<ref name="TCWCE" /> earned in battle.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> Chopper came to hold the battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] in contempt,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and he even began to take the war personally.<ref name="TCWCE" /> He was eventually assigned to [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]].<ref name="OEG:S1" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], seven [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] into the war,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] was dispatched with a contingent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On Christophsis, Slick's unit was tasked with reconnoitering the planet for a suitable site that the Republic could use to ambush the droids, and Chopper and his comrades set off on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] to scout out some potential locations.<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref> In the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]],<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]],<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> the clones found a candidate for an ambush site: a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|business center]] overlooking a large plaza with towers facing the north and south. After reporting their success to their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Slick and his men returned to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]].<ref name="Shadowed" />

Along the way, the platoon chanced upon a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that was clearing a major boulevard of [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] civilians, and Slick had Chopper and fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] keep an eye on the droids while the clones parked their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. When the battle droids came across a crippled Christophsian and discussed killing the man, the clones intervened and eliminated the droids. Yet, Chopper was disgusted with the crippled [[Refugee/Legends|refugee's]] cowardice and threw a battle droid leg at him, insulting him and rudely telling him to use it as a crutch. He then returned to the Republic base with his platoon.<ref name="Shadowed" />

With the information that Slick and his unit had gathered, the Republic forces put their plan to ambush the droids into action. Chopper and the rest of Slick's unit were stationed in the south tower with Kenobi and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] were based with their troopers in the parallel north tower. As the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] prepared to attack the Confederate droids below, however, the approaching droid column suddenly split in two, and battle droids launched an assault on the clones in the south tower, compromising the Republic's position. That change of events forced the Republic troops to abandon their ambush plan and regroup in the south tower, from the roof of which the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones retreated in [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]]. After the Republic forces had returned to their base, Chopper skulked around the base's south exit and privately strung several battle droid fingers&mdash;items that were forbidden by war protocols to be taken from a battlefield&mdash;together in a necklace as war trophies. He later joined fellow platoon members Sketch and [[Punch/Legends|Punch]] in the base's mess hall.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

[[File:Slickssquad.png|thumb|right|250px|Chopper and the other members of Slick's platoon discover their sergeant's betrayal.]]
Chopper and the others were eventually recalled to their barracks along with the rest of their unit so that CC-2224 and CT-7567&mdash;nicknamed "Cody" and "Rex," respectively&mdash;could interrogate them. The two clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were after a suspected Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] amongst their ranks, and their tracing of an irregular wavelength in external communications to the platoon's barracks had led them to surmise that one of Slick's men was the Separatist agent. Rex and Cody began to question each of the troopers, and when it was his turn, Chopper hid his droid finger necklace and claimed that he had immediately gone to the mess hall after returning to the base with the others. However, Sketch challenged his alibi and cited that Chopper had not joined them in the mess hall until much later, forcing Chopper to reveal his protocol-breaking actions. Slick used Chopper's lie as evidence in accusing him of being the spy, but when his [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] stated that he would be given a proper investigation when the Jedi returned, Chopper retaliated, recalling that he had witnessed the sergeant entering the base's command center instead of his platoon's barracks earlier that evening. That, along with Slick's inadvertent revelation of his awareness that the Jedi had left on a confidential mission, prompted Cody to confront Slick on his knowledge of the restricted information.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

Briefly admitting to his allegiances as a Separatist spy, Slick knocked Cody and Chopper over before fleeing the barracks, leaving his platoon shocked with the revelation of their sergeant's [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Republic. After [[Saboteur/Legends|severely damaging]] the Republic's [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]], and weapons depot, Slick was spotted running into the base's command center. With Slick's platoon securing the perimeter, Rex and Cody managed to apprehend Slick and turn him in to the Jedi.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Of all the blasted&hellip; You want a ''crutch?'' Try ''this'' one! 'Fraid I don't have a ''spine'' for you!''"<br />"''Easy, Chopper. We're not in this for the gratitude.|Chopper insults a crippled Christophsian and receives a rebuke from a fellow member of Slick's platoon|<ref name="Shadowed" />}}
[[File:Chopper-in-Slicks-face.png|thumb|left|250px|Chopper unabashedly confronts his own sergeant.]]
An unusual clone<ref name="OEG:S1" /><ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> with an odd personality,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> Chopper took a personal stance in the war.<ref name="TCWCE" /> He held a grudge against the battle droids of the Separatist Army,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> believing that the machines that had caused his scarring<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> owed him something.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> His hatred for the droids led him to express some crude humor to a crippled Christophsian whose cowardice he considered to be repugnant.<ref name="Shadowed" /> In battle, the other members of his unit felt that Chopper gunned down battle droids with a frightening mixture of joy and rage, and his comrades thus deemed him to be rather peculiar.<ref name="TCWCE" /> To fuel his contempt for his mechanical adversaries, Chopper stole fingers from droid wreckage on the battlefield<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and made grim<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> war trophies out of them.<ref name="OEG:S1" /> He additionally attempted to hide his crime by both sequestering himself when making a droid finger necklace, and using a false alibi to mask his whereabouts during Rex and Cody's interrogation. He was even willing to lie to his commanding officers to hide his violation of protocol, though he was not successful in covering up the truth. In the opinion of fellow trooper [[Gus/Legends|Gus]], Chopper's actions represented a form of deficiency.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

When his trustworthiness and character were questioned by Sergeant Slick, Chopper appealed to Rex and Cody, his commanding officers, to attempt to make his voice heard over his sergeant's accusations. When Slick continued to put him on the spot, however, the cornered Chopper rounded on his own sergeant and was quick to put the spotlight on him, aggressively questioning the officer's own whereabouts. The trooper's pursuits played a key role in revealing Slick's role as a Separatist spy.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> A Human male, Chopper [[Hair dye|dyed]] and shaved his hair, though he attained severe facial scarring and eye discoloration in the course of his service.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> He stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had tan skin. He was trained in combat,<ref name="TCWCE" /> to the point that Slick deemed his skill to be noteworthy,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and he was additionally skilled with machines.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Equipment==
Chopper wielded a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] in combat.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|His wiring isn't quite right either. The clones aren't so regimented in repeated cookie cutters as you might think. Even though Chopper doesn't do anything wrong, he breaks a rule, and he's out there pulling droid fingers off and making a little necklace. If I were Obi-Wan and Anakin, I'd loop back around and ask that guy a couple more questions, because that's&hellip; a little weird.|''The Clone Wars'' Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] comments on Chopper's character|<ref name="HEComment">{{SWArchive|url=watch/hiddenenemy_commentary.html|text=''The Hidden Enemy'' commentary|nobackup=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:Chopper-TCWCE.png|thumb|right|300px|Chopper's battle droid necklace was inspired by the actions of some real&ndash;world soldiers.]]
The character of Chopper was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> He first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']]<ref name="Shadowed" /> and the episode it led into, "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," which aired on [[February 6]], [[2009]] as part of the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> and served as the prime Separatist spy suspect in the episode before the traitor was revealed to be Sergeant Slick.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Commentary">{{SW|url=video/the-hidden-enemy-episode-featurette|text="The Hidden Enemy" Episode Featurette}}</ref>

Chopper was originally to appear in another scene of "The Hidden Enemy," during the Republic forces' preparations in the South tower for an attack on the Separatists. He was to help set up a sabotage droid nicknamed "The Beast" that was to lure the battle droids into the Republic's ambush. His visible attachment for the droid would have been a direct contrast with his willingness to "casually" disobey war protocols with his construction of his battle droid finger necklace later in the episode. As indicated by the script, the Beast would be unsuccessful, and the clones would be forced to retreat. Nevertheless, the scene was ultimately cut to keep the battle focused on the "clones versus droids" perspective, and not the confusing element of the clones themselves utilizing a droid against the Separatists.<ref name="OEG:S1" />

Chopper's right eye changes color during "The Hidden Enemy." Both of his eyes are the same brown color until Slick puts his character into question. From then on in the episode, his right eye is a light yellow color,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> an indication to one of the numerous injuries he received earlier in the war.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> The necklace of droid fingers Chopper keeps was intended as a parallel to real&ndash;world soldiers who would keep human remains from battlefields as trophies.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy featurette">{{SW|url=video/the-hidden-enemy-episode-featurette|text="The Hidden Enemy" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
